final: WITH player_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM manager_award) SELECT pc.player_id, pc.award_count, CAST(pc.award_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as fraction FROM player_counts pc, total_count tc WHERE tc.total > 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
